notes.title: Demo Update July 2025
notes.notes:
We just dropped a fresh update for the Hell Games demo. Here's what's new:



🔥 Reworked weapon mechanics – smoother, deadlier, more fun  

🎯 Visual and graphic improvements – hell has never looked this good  

ːwinter2019coolyulː New traps – because dodging fireballs wasn’t enough 

🌀 Improved level transitions – more fluid, more immersive  

🧠 UI/UX overhaul – easier to navigate, better to play 

🌎 Additional stages - more room for fighting



Meanwhile, we're working hard behind the scenes to bring you the full version of Hell Games. It's taking some time – but it’s coming. Thanks for your patience and support!

Your feedback means the world to us. Try out the new version and let us know what you think – or what you'd like to see next. More madness is coming!

notes.title: Update February 2025
notes.notes:
Fiery updates you can expect from the newest version of the Hell Games demo:


 New feature: destructible objects
 New map, designed by our intern Lukas
 Balancing changes
 Overhauled lighting
 New settings menu
 Choosable Player Colors
 Colorblind options
 Minor changes and fixes


Happy Gaming!
